summary: SRX Global Inc. filed an 8-K to report a secured financing transaction with CERo Therapeutics Holdings. SRX issued a Consolidated Senior Secured Promissory Note consolidating prior notes of $5,666,108.77, with additional advances up to $6,000,000, totaling $11,666,108.77. An initial advance of $775,665 was funded on August 27, 2026. The note bears 10% interest (24.99% default rate) and matures October 15, 2026, with four 30-day extension options. Proceeds fund working capital and trade payables. This is a routine credit facility, not a special situation.
